claim_summary: Existing internally audited parameter-independent fully separable decoder has uniform O_(M,B)(N^(-1/4)) whole-density error for fixed public bounds.
The known-parameter O(N^(-3/2)) separable approximation and O(N^(-1/2)) coherent reverse bridge are different interfaces.
Integration-by-parts cancellation may improve the product decoder rate to O(N^(-1/2)); this remains an unproved attack hypothesis.
